entries.17e48ae7284190a7: A business that makes and sells machine tools and industrial sewing machines. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥82,969 million, an increase of 23.3% from the prior year (after reclassification). Industrial equipment centered on machine tools grew significantly on expanded capital investment in automotive and general machinery in China and Asia, while industrial sewing machines declined as capital investment for apparel in Asia was sluggish due to the effects of U.S. tariff policy. The company began machine tool production at its Indian subsidiary in December 2024, and in January 2026 acquired the automotive parts division of Germany's Konrad Busche, strengthening the non-apparel field of industrial sewing machines, such as automotive interior parts.

entries.97dce5c9ca52a7a8: This business manufactures and sells household sewing machines. The company explains that the increase was due to solid sales of entry-level and mid-range models in each region, the effect of pricing measures, and a positive impact from foreign exchange. entries.ac01f816339132d2: A business that makes and sells industrial printing equipment used in factories and other settings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥139,291 million, an increase of 1.5% from the prior year (after reclassification). Domino's consumables were firm and increased, while industrial printers declined significantly due to a deteriorating competitive environment in Europe and the Americas. This segment was newly established in the fiscal year ended March 2026, combining the business centered on garment printers, previously in the Machinery Business, with the Domino business.
